title: Restaurant (official food-hygiene listing)
description: One record: one place that serves food (restaurant, cafe, takeaway, pub or bar) as an official food-safety authority lists it: name, address, coordinates and its latest published hygiene rating, grade or inspection result with that rating's date. Voyager use: activities (food), places to eat near the itinerary.

name.description: Business name as the authority lists it.

establishment_type.description: Kind of food business, from the authority's own category.

category_label.description: The authority's own category as written (e.g. "Restaurant/Cafe/Canteen").

cuisine.description: Cuisine as the authority lists it (e.g. "Italian").

address.description: Street address as written, including the postcode when given.

city.description: City in English. Always paired with `country`.

country.description: Country in English (e.g. "United Kingdom"). Required whenever `city` is set.

lat.description: Latitude, only when the source states coordinates.

lng.description: Longitude, only when the source states coordinates.

phone.description: Phone number. As written by the source (digits, spaces, +, -, (, ), .).

hygiene.description: The latest published food-hygiene rating, grade or inspection result.

scheme.description: Rating scheme: UK Food Hygiene Rating Scheme (0-5), Scotland's Food Hygiene Information Scheme (Pass / Improvement Required), New York City letter grades (A-C), Toronto DineSafe (Pass / Conditional Pass / Closed).

rating.description: The rating, grade or result exactly as published (e.g. "5", "Pass", "A", "Conditional Pass").

rating_value.description: The numeric rating on a 0-5 scale, only for schemes that publish a number (UK FHRS).

rating_date.description: Date of the inspection that produced the rating or grade (YYYY-MM-DD).

authority.description: The inspecting authority (e.g. "Westminster", "NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene").

source_url.description: The page's own link for this item (official site, booking or detail page), copied verbatim from the page.

as_of.description: The "last updated", "valid from" or publication date the page itself states for this information (YYYY-MM-DD).

items.description: A verbatim quote from the page.

evidence.description: Up to 3 short verbatim quotes from the page that support the most important facts.
